welcome.title: FamilyForward AI
welcome.tagline: A free weekly learning plan for your family, in your language.
welcome.footerNote: Free for families. No ads. We never sell your data.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.point1: Plans are general learning ideas, not advice about your child's development.
consent.point2: We never ask for your child's name, birthday or school.
consent.point3: Free, with no ads. We don't share or sell your data.

signIn.title: Sign in with your email
signIn.subtitle: We'll send you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
signIn.emailHelper: We only use your email to sign you in.
signIn.emailError: Please enter a full email address, like name@example.com.

code.title: Check your email
code.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}. It works for 10 minutes.
code.subtitleShort: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.wrong: That code isn't right. You have {{tries}} tries left. Check the numbers and try again.
code.lockedBody: Codes work for 10 minutes and allow 5 tries. Let's send you a new one.

sessionExpired.title: Please sign in again
sessionExpired.body: It's been a while, so we signed you out to keep your account safe. Your plans are still here.

age.title: How old is your child?
age.helper: We use this only to pick activities. We don't ask for a birthday.

focus.title: What would you like to focus on?

time.title: How much time do you have?
time.helper: Short is fine. A few minutes still helps.

materials.title: What do you have at home?
materials.helper: We only suggest things you already have.

note.title: Anything else we should know?
note.helper: Optional. Please don't include names or health details.
note.label: Your note
note.placeholder: For example: we like short activities before bedtime
note.healthBody: We can't give advice about your child's development. If you have questions, you can talk to your child's doctor or teacher. We'll still make a learning plan with fun activities for you.

generating.title: Building your plan
generating.subtitle: This usually takes a few seconds.

plan.title: Your week
plan.disclaimer: These are general learning ideas, not advice about your child's development.
plan.fallbackLead: We couldn't make a custom plan this time.
plan.fallbackBody: Here is a ready-made plan that fits your answers. You can try again later.
plan.retry: Try making a custom plan again
plan.offlineBody: Your plan is saved on this phone, so you can still do this week's activities.
plan.offlineNote: Making a new plan needs the internet. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data to build one.
plan.empty: You don't have a plan yet.

done.title: Nice work together!
done.body: Every few minutes of time together helps. See you for the next activity.
done.question: Was this activity a good fit?

weekComplete.title: This week is done
weekComplete.body_one: You did {{n}} activity together. Ready for next week?
weekComplete.body_other: You did {{n}} activities together. Ready for next week?

help.title: Free help near you
help.subtitle: Places that offer free learning and family support.
help.libraryBody: Free books, story times and children's programs. Ask for a free library card.
help.programsBody: Ask your school or childcare center about free preschool and family programs.
help.callBody: A free service that helps you find local food, housing, childcare and other support.
help.notice: If you have questions about your child's development, you can talk to your child's doctor or teacher.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: We keep your email, your plan settings and your plans. We never ask for your child's name, birthday or school, and we never sell or share your data.

signOutSheet.title: Sign out?
signOutSheet.body: Your plans stay saved. You can sign back in with your email at any time.

deleteSheet.title: Delete all your data?
deleteSheet.body: This removes your email, your answers and all your plans. This can't be undone.

pastWeeks.title: Past weeks
pastWeeks.empty: No past weeks yet. Your finished weeks will show up here.
pastWeeks.note: Past plans stay on your phone and in your account. You can open any of them again.

about.title: Privacy and about
about.whatIsBody: A free app that gives families a weekly plan of short learning activities for ages 2 to 5, in English, Spanish or Arabic. It was built with ChiEAC.
about.whatNotBody: It is not a test or an evaluation. It gives general learning ideas, not advice about your child's development.
about.keep1: Your email, to sign you in
about.never1: Ask for your child's name, birthday or school
